# Vladimir Vishar

> Official personal portfolio of Vladimir Vishar, a realism tattoo artist accepting enquiries for future London appointments.

## About

- Specialities: colour realism, black-and-grey realism, custom large-scale tattoos, and cover-ups by assessment.
- Current hourly rate: £140/hr.
- Main call to action: "Send your concept."
- Enquiries are sent directly to Vladimir for review, and a consultation may take place before any booking is confirmed.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://vishartattoo.com/): Overview of Vladimir Vishar's realism tattoo work, specialities, and London booking status.
- [Tattoo Enquiry](https://vishartattoo.com/booking/): Personal London booking form for tattoo concepts, placement, size and reference images.
- [About](https://vishartattoo.com/about/): Background on the artist, process, pricing and London appointments.
- [Colour Realism](https://vishartattoo.com/colour-realism-tattoo-london/): Colour realism tattoo work — portraits, wildlife, and floral pieces.
- [Black & Grey Realism](https://vishartattoo.com/black-and-grey-realism-london/): Black-and-grey realism tattoo work with dramatic contrast and shading.
- [Cover-Ups](https://vishartattoo.com/cover-up-tattoo-london/): Cover-up tattoos, assessed individually before booking.
- [FAQ](https://vishartattoo.com/faq/): Common questions about sessions, preparation, pain, healing, and cover-ups.
- [Aftercare](https://vishartattoo.com/aftercare/): Step-by-step tattoo aftercare and healing guidance.
